Indian auto industry sees 26% surge in retail sales for July

The Indian auto industry reported a total retail sales of 25,91,138 units in July, with a 26% increase from the previous year. The Federation of Automobile Dealers Associations (FADA) attributed this growth to various factors. The government has been promoting electric vehicles and reducing import duties to boost domestic production. However, some critics argue that the surge in sales is largely driven by low-cost imports, which may not be sustainable in the long term.
